I can see the issue—this is a classic floating-point precision problem. When you multiply 39.95 by 100 to convert to cents, you get 3995.0000000000005 instead of 3995 due to how binary floating-point numbers work. Netflix and Spotify work because 12.99 × 100 and 10.99 × 100 happen to round cleanly.

The fix is to round the result to ensure we always get a whole number of cents:
